lead.claim: Don't fear tech for older adults; tele-exercise is feasible for fall risk patients.
lead.context: Why this matters: This qualitative study looked at older adults' engagement with tele-exercise, even those with initial digital literacy barriers.

supporting.claim: Current training for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists has systemic gaps.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This qualitative study explored the education and training experiences of advanced musculoskeletal practitioners.

supporting.claim: You can track knee flexion continuously for 5 days using wearable IMUs.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study demonstrated a method for synchronizing wearable IMUs to track knee flexion for 5 days continuously.

supporting.claim: Exercise modality doesn't change body composition for breast cancer patients.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This randomized trial examined phase angle and body composition in breast cancer patients undergoing different training modalities.

supporting.claim: Can supramaximal eccentric loading build strength with low training volumes?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This narrative review synthesized evidence on supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading and its potential for strength gains.
